settings.heading: Overview
settings.body:
SemiProbe programmable manipulators provide motorised X, Y, and Z positioning of probe arms and probe tips on any probe system — analytical, production or benchtop. A complete manipulator includes the manipulator body, base, adjustable probe arm faceplate, probe arm, controller, joystick controller, cables and power supply.

The family spans three model series — the MA-9000 PM for precision characterisation, the MA-9100 PM offering 100 TPI and sub-micron positioning, and the MA-8500 PM engineered for high-frequency and millimetre-wave applications. All are small footprint and available with 4 or 8 axis controllers. Open air and vacuum compatible versions are available, and the entire line of SemiProbe probe arms can be mounted.

settings.heading: Choosing a Configuration
settings.bar_text: Probing at sub-micron feature sizes, or planning a multi-manipulator system?

settings.title: START WITH FEATURE SIZE
settings.description: Determine the smallest pad or trace geometry you need to probe. For features from 1 µm to 5 µm, the MA-9000 PM provides precision characterisation performance. For sub-micron structures (<1 µm), the 100 TPI resolution of the MA-9100 PM is essential.

settings.title: MATCH THE PLATFORM TO YOUR SIGNAL
settings.description: For DC, low-frequency and optical work, the MA-9000 PM and MA-9100 PM accept coaxial, triaxial, Kelvin and fiber optic arms. For RF, microwave and millimetre-wave measurement, the MA-8500 PM is built around West/East and North/South high-frequency probe arms.

settings.title: SIZE THE CONTROLLER TO YOUR STATION
settings.description: Programmable manipulators are driven by a 4 unit or 8 unit controller. Up to four manipulators can run from the 4-unit controller and up to eight from the 8-unit controller. The listed price covers one complete manipulator; contact the factory for a quote covering two to eight.

settings.question: How many manipulators can one controller drive?
settings.answer: Up to four manipulators run from the 4-unit controller and up to eight from the 8-unit controller. The price shown here covers one (1) complete programmable manipulator for non-vacuum applications. For a system of two to eight, contact the factory and we will quote the manipulators and the matching controller together.

settings.question: What is the difference between a programmable and a manual manipulator?
settings.answer: The mechanics are shared, but a programmable manipulator replaces the micrometer drums with motorised axes under a programmable controller, so positions can be stored, repeated and driven from a joystick or host software. Manual manipulators remain the better choice for single-station work where positions are set by hand.

settings.question: Can I mount any SemiProbe probe arm on a programmable manipulator?
settings.answer: Yes. The entire line of SemiProbe probe arms mounts on the programmable manipulators via the adjustable dovetail faceplate. Check the compatibility table above for the arm types matched to each model, and note that the MA-8500 PM is configured specifically for high-frequency arms.

settings.question: Are vacuum compatible versions available?
settings.answer: Yes. Open air and vacuum compatible versions are both available. Most programmable manipulators are configured with magnetic bases, but vacuum and bolt-down bases can be supplied — tell us your platen and application and we will confirm the right base before you order.

settings.question: Do programmable manipulators come calibrated?
settings.answer: Yes. Every unit ships calibrated to NIST Standard Class A, and the lead time is 2 to 3 weeks after receipt of order.
